$comment: Command Governor worker profile. Copy this file to <project>/.pi/settings.json
in a project a worker will run in, then add the Command Governor package pin.
Add it as an exact, immutable source:
Pi treats any git ref as `pinned`, including a mutable branch or tag, and it
keeps no lockfile for the packages it installs -- so only a full commit SHA
is actually a pin. `packages` is left empty here rather than carrying a
placeholder, because a fake pin that passes a policy check is worse than no
`defaultTools` in a project settings file REPLACES the global array rather
than merging with it, which is what makes this a least-authority loadout and
not a suggestion. Note the limit honestly: this restricts which tools the
session starts with. It is not a sandbox. Pi runs with the permissions of
the user that launched it, and `bash` can reach anything that user can.
Launch through bin/cg-pi, not `pi`. Headless Pi never prompts for project
trust and, under the default setting, silently ignores this entire file.
